## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, what changes, and any user-visible effect.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Appropriate device/browser checks, or verification limits documented

## Privacy and safety impact

Describe changes to location access, data retention, authorization, tagging, or safe-zone behavior. Never include actual player coordinates, room codes or session tokens.
